title: Offline Evaluation Measures of Fairness in Recommender Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating individual item fairness by measuring disparities in item exposure and relevance-aware exposure distributions across recommendations using metrics like the Gini Index, Jain's Index, and Distance to Pareto Frontier.
Quantifying user-side unfairness by measuring the pairwise difference in recommendation effectiveness (e.g., NDCG) between similar users, weighted by their interaction-based similarity.
Measuring disparities in recommendation effectiveness between male and female user groups using group fairness metrics.
Evaluating recommendation effectiveness disparities across different user age brackets using group fairness evaluation measures.
Measuring recommendation performance disparities across users from different countries and continents.
Evaluating disparities in job recommendation effectiveness across users with different academic degrees and study majors.
Measuring disparities in recommendation effectiveness between working and non-working user groups, as well as across professional experience levels.
